### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you’re looking for a high\-profile, challenging opportunity supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has an exciting opportunity for you. This position will join a dynamic team supporting Team Submarine. Bring your expertise, technical skills, and collaborative approach to a mission\-critical role that helps advance U.S. national security and the safety and effectiveness of our Sailors.


**Ability to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**


About the Program


Program Executive Office Submarines, Program Manager for the Virginia\-Class Submarine (PMS 450\), is responsible for the acquisition of the U.S. Navy’s Virginia\-Class nuclear\-powered attack submarines. PMS 450 identifies, assembles, manages, directs, and coordinates the resources required for research and development, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T\&E), Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT\&E), and fleet introduction.


PMS 450 is responsible for developing and deploying an affordable, nuclear\-powered attack submarine with multi\-mission capabilities and enhanced performance in littoral environments. Virginia\-Class submarines support five of the Navy’s six core maritime capabilities: Deterrence, Maritime Security, Sea Control, Forward Presence, and Power Projection.

  



The Opportunity


Serco is seeking an Onboarding and Systems Specialist to manage the end\-to\-end integration of personnel and streamline administrative workflows for the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine organization, specifically supporting the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, DC.


In this role, you will oversee onboarding and offboarding processes for civilian, military, and contractor personnel while serving as a primary administrator for Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform automated workflows. You will help modernize administrative processes, improve workforce visibility, and develop digital solutions that increase efficiency across the program.


This is an excellent opportunity to join our team and contribute to the delivery of cutting\-edge undersea warfare capabilities for the U.S. Navy.

  



What You’ll Do


* Manage the end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding lifecycle for civilian, military, and contractor personnel assigned to the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program, ensuring a seamless transition into and out of the organization.
* Maintain, configure, and continuously improve the program’s onboarding systems, databases, and portal pages hosted on Microsoft SharePoint.
* Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain custom Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate workflows to streamline manual routing, data entry, approvals, notifications, and other administrative processes.
* Collaborate with adjacent Team Submarine program offices to support their onboarding operations, share best practices, and expand successful automation solutions across the organization.
* Coordinate with security managers, IT support teams, facilities personnel, and sponsor representatives to ensure timely provisioning of physical workspaces, Common Access Cards (CACs)/badges, network accounts, computer equipment, and other required resources.
* Maintain accurate personnel rosters, onboarding records, and historical staffing data.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reports to support workforce planning, program reviews, and leadership decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes through automation, standardization, and digital transformation.

Provide user support and troubleshooting for SharePoint\-based onboarding tools and automated workflows.  
* 

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business management, computer science, or a related field and minimum 8 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, workflow automation, SharePoint administration, Microsoft Power Platform solutions, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* **Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Demonstrated experience building and managing Microsoft SharePoint sites, including custom lists, libraries, pages, and site structures.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Hands\-on experience developing applications using Microsoft Power Apps.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to travel approximately 10% of the time.

Desired Qualifications


* Experience supporting personnel onboarding, workforce operations, or administrative processes within a DoD/Navy acquisition program office, Program Executive Office (PEO), or Navy command environment.
* Experience gathering and translating requirements from non\-technical stakeholders into intuitive, user\-friendly digital forms, applications, and workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to identify administrative bottlenecks, analyze complex operational processes, and develop and implement digital solutions that improve efficiency.
* Experience developing SharePoint\-based dashboards, reporting tools, or workforce tracking solutions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
* Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across military, civilian, contractor, and government organizations.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a diverse, mission\-focused team.
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  

  

To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/what\-we\-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco\-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800\-628\-6458, option 1\. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  

  

Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government\-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. For more information on how Serco uses your information, please see our Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice.

All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Serco and will not be obligated to pay a placement or contract fee. If you are interested in becoming an approved vendor at Serco, please email Agencies@serco\-na.com.
  

  

Serco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

  

  

### **Pay Transparency**

  

  

Our Total Rewards package includes competitive pay, performance\-based incentives, and benefits that promote well\-being and work\-life balance—so you can thrive both professionally and personally. Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time\-off programs that support work\-life balance. Program availability may vary based on factors such as contract type, location, hire date, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.
  

  

Salary range: The range for this position can be found at the top of this posting. This range is provided as a general guideline and represents a good faith estimate across all experience levels. Actual base salary will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the scope of the role, relevant experience, job\-related knowledge, education and training, key skills, and geographic market considerations. For roles available in multiple states, the range may vary to reflect differences in local labor markets. In addition to base salary, eligible positions may include other forms of compensation such as annual bonuses or long\-term incentive opportunities. To review all Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/about\-us.
  

  

Serco complies with all applicable state and local leave laws, including providing time off under the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for eligible Colorado residents, in alignment with our policies and benefit plans. The application window for this position is for no more than 60 days. jobs.title: Lead EHR Clinical Apps Analyst (Epic Billing), Remote - ITS-Clin Revenue Cycle
jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications:**


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and five years of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to conduct clinical applications analysis and/or programming of complex systems, analysis of clinical workflows, and system adoption strategies. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.  



  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Epic Billing Certification.
* 3 to 5 years of Epic billing experience.
* Relevant experience at a healthcare or academic institution.

 **Job Summary:**


This position is responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, optimization, maintenance, and support of complex clinical systems to improve in compliance with all applicable regulations and organizational policies. Clinical applications include any software application used in support of the clinical enterprise including patient registration, patient billing, clinical documentation utilized in the ambulatory and inpatient settings, as well as applications for specific medical specialties such as, but not limited to, Radiology, Pathology, Oncology, Transplant, and Cardiology. Other responsibilities include providing advanced analysis and documentation, formulating logical statements of business and management problems to develop requirements for configuration of clinical applications, and providing solutions to complex problems. This role requires an understanding of the assigned system applications, functions, and features end\-users would experience. Has full technical knowledge of all phases of clinical applications programming.

 **Job Duties:**


The Lead Epic Billing Analyst serves as the primary expert for Epic Billing workflows, projects, and system configuration. The analyst partners closely with operational teams to maintain a stable, compliant, and optimized Epic environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead configuration, testing, and maintenance of Epic billing workflows.
* Troubleshoot complex Epic Billing issues and serve as the main escalation point for operational teams.
* Lead billing‑related projects, enhancements, and optimization efforts.

Remote position. 8 am to 5 pm, and as needed on occasion.

**Position Summary:**  

  

The primary responsibilities of an EMR Analyst include developing an in\-depth knowledge of the software with primary focus in the application or area of his or her assigned support area. The analyst will be responsible for troubleshooting reported issues within the software and analyzing the root cause in order to determine resolution. The analyst is responsible for design, build, test, validation and support of the software on an ongoing basis. The analyst must work collaboratively with other application teams and operational owners.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Effectively communicates to end users and leadership regarding build changes and project plans.

jobs.title: Corporate Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Business Unit Overview:
**Michael Foods, Inc. is a leader in the food processing and distribution industry with business in egg products, refrigerated grocery and potato products. We offer exciting job possibilities throughout our organization where you can enhance your career, sharpen your talents and make an impact. Join our company and be part of an innovative team that’s First in Food***.*
Location Description: Michael Foods, Inc. located in Gaylord, Minnesota is Minnesota's Healthy Heartland! Gaylord is located in south central Minnesota about an hour west of the Twin Cities and 35 minutes from Mankato, Hutchinson, and New Ulm. As the County Seat, Gaylord is the "Hub of Sibley County." Our location produces liquid egg, hardcook egg, and precooked egg such as scrambled, patties and omelets. Responsibilities:
**POSITION SUMMARY****:**

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Training Coordinator to join our Corporate Food Safety and Quality (FSQ) team. In this pivotal role, you will help shape a culture of excellence by empowering teams to uphold the highest food safety and quality standards across all food manufacturing facilities. You will design, implement, manage, and evaluate training programs that extend beyond compliance to build knowledge, reinforce behaviors, and drive consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement. Leveraging adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies, you will identify training needs, create effective learning materials, and lead initiatives that support organizational capability and performance. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Strategic Design and Develop Training Materials**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the assessment of company\-wide FSQ training needs in partnership with stakeholders to establish strategic learning priorities.
* Interpret existing standard operating procedures and observe undocumented processes to create clear, structured training content that drives consistency and effective learning.
* Design and develop engaging, role\-specific training materials that support onboarding and ongoing development for facility and corporate team members, using best practices in instructional design and content creation.
* Leverage translation tools and verify translations to support multilingual and diverse audiences.
* Champion the modernization and enhancement of existing training materials to enhance clarity, engagement, and alignment with current practices and expectations.
* Ensure training meets internal standards and external requirements (i.e. FDA, USDA, SQF).
* Align training initiatives with succession planning and leadership development to drive long\-term talent growth and measurable improvements in employee and organizational capabilities.
* Stay current on regulatory changes, industry trends, and innovations in learning and development to continuously evolve training strategies and tools.

**Company\-wide Implementation and Delivery of Training Programs**

* Manage the deployment of training programs related to food safety, quality, and sanitation across all manufacturing facilities, ensuring strategic alignment and consistent execution.
* Deliver Train\-the\-Trainer sessions to empower facilitators with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to lead high\-impact training and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Facilitate engaging classroom, hands\-on, and virtual training sessions for both hourly and salaried employees, across all shifts to ensure accessibility for all team members.

**Training System Management and Oversight**

* Oversee LMS activities, including content uploads, learning plan assignments, reporting, and compliance tracking, while guiding facility teams to ensure accessibility and usability.
* Establish protocols to ensure facilities maintain accurate, audit\-ready training records aligned with corporate, regulatory, and customer requirements.

**Training Evaluation, Optimization and Continuous Improvement**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators to evaluate training effectiveness, identify gaps, and implement targeted improvements.
* Apply data\-driven methods to assess learning outcomes, behavior change, and business impact.
* Continuously update training materials based on process changes, audit results, and insights from employee performance and behavior.


Qualifications:
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* Degree in Instructional Design, Learning Design and Technology, Organizational Development, Organizational Leadership, or a closely related field in Learning and Development or Training.
* 5\+ years of experience in an instructional design related field, preferably in food manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success in leading enterprise\-wide learning initiatives that align with corporate strategy, drive measurable performance improvements, and support organizational transformation.

**EXPERIENCE PREFERRED:**

* Knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including regulatory frameworks such as FSMA, GFSI (e.g., SQF, BRC), HACCP, and GMPs, with experience integrating these into training programs.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong communication and engagement skills, with a proven ability to lead through influence, fostering alignment and driving action across cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Skilled in coaching and mentoring facility\-based trainers to elevate training effectiveness and drive sustainable workforce capability development through influential leadership.
* Project management capabilities, including experience with large\-scale rollouts, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to simplify complex regulatory and technical content into scalable, learner\-centric training solutions using modern instructional design methodologies.
* Analytical mindset with experience applying data\-driven evaluation models to assess training effectiveness and business impact.
* Proficiency with a wide range of learning technologies and content development tools (e.g. Alchemy Creator, Synthesia, Adobe Premiere Pro, PowerPoint, CoPilot).
* Fluency in multiple languages, such as English and Spanish, is a plus.
* Periodic travel (not to exceed 50%) to lead training development and execution across all facilities.

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of the work and may not include all the duties associated with this position.
 

: The pay range for this position is $80,166 \- $118,645 per year.
